hero.title: Welcome to SeArt Surf Camp
hero.subtitle: Your summer sanctuary at Banana Beach, Tamraght. Surf, chill, and experience the real Moroccan vibe.

about.titleStart: A surf camp for waves, work and
about.copy: SeArt is minutes from Banana Beach and built for travelers who want more than a bed: coached surf sessions, a warm social rhythm, reliable work corners and simple access to the Agadir coast.

coaching.title: Surf coaching
coaching.desc: Daily lessons with equipment, beach transport and level-based coaching.

daysOut.title: Moroccan days out
daysOut.desc: Markets, Paradise Valley, desert routes and slow evenings after the ocean.

nights.title: Community nights
nights.desc: Shared dinners, live music, rooftop sunsets and campfire conversations.

rooms.copy: Choose a social dorm bed or a private room. Both include access to shared spaces, rooftop, Wi-Fi and camp support.

dorm.title: Premium Dorms
dorm.copy: Bunk beds with privacy curtains, reading lights and lockers for solo travelers or friends.

private.title: Private Suites
private.copy: A quieter room with a queen-size bed, private feel and bohemian coastal details.

about.title: Built for travelers who want surf, comfort and community.
about.subtitle: SeArt Surf Camp sits in Tamraght, close to Banana Beach and the classic Agadir surf coastline. Quality surf days, warm Moroccan hosting, calm shared spaces and enough flexibility for beginners, solo travelers and digital nomads.

waves.title: Surf that fits your level
waves.copy: Lessons and spot choices are matched to the conditions and your confidence in the water.

rooftop.title: A social rooftop rhythm
rooftop.copy: Breakfast, sunsets and relaxed evenings make it easy to meet people without forcing a party hostel mood.

remote.title: Remote-work friendly
remote.copy: Wi-Fi, calmer corners and longer-stay packages make work days realistic between surf sessions.

food.title: Moroccan food culture
food.copy: Fresh local meals, dietary options and shared dinners are part of the stay.

about.whereTitleStart: Tamraght gives you the surf coast without losing the
about.whereCopy: You are close to surf breaks, cafes, markets and Agadir airport while staying in a quieter village atmosphere.

rooms.title: Choose the stay that fits your trip.
rooms.subtitle: Both room types keep you close to shared camp life, the rooftop and the surf schedule.
rooms.dormCopy: A social and budget-friendly option for solo travelers, friends and anyone who wants to meet the camp community quickly.
rooms.privateCopy: A quieter base for couples, remote workers or travelers who want privacy while keeping access to the camp experience.

packages.title: Choose the rhythm of your Moroccan surf holiday.
packages.subtitle: All packages include accommodation, breakfast, camp facilities and local guidance. We confirm exact dates and room availability after your request.

gallery.title: A look at the waves, rooms and shared camp moments.
gallery.subtitle: Real visual texture matters for a travel decision.

faq.title: Useful answers before you arrive.
faq.subtitle: For anything specific about your dates, surf level or transfer, send a message and we will confirm directly.
faq.stillBody: Send your travel dates, group size and surf level. We will help you choose the right stay.

contact.title: Tell us your dates and we will help shape the stay.
contact.subtitle: Share your group size, surf level, preferred room type and arrival airport. The fastest way to confirm availability is WhatsApp.
